title: Drag + POI Integration Page Assembly
plan_reference: Runtime Component Alignment Plan - Integration Assembly
objectives: Create integration page demonstrating drag & drop to POI components
Serve as verification harness for drag + POI integration
Verify roster system integrates correctly with POI components
Ensure time layer usage is consistent (gameplay layer)
invariants: Component Reuse: Use existing canonical components (VillageRosterSection, ActivityCapsule, PoiDetailSkinWrapper)
Drag & Drop: Use DragContext and DragOverlay canonics from RT-ROSTER-001
Time Layer: Use gameplay layer time for UI interactions (dual-layer architecture)
Style Lab: Apply Style Lab tokens for theming
Config-first: No hardcoded values - use existing config patterns

operations.description: Create DragPoiIntegrationPage.tsx that mounts VillageRosterSection, ActivityCapsule examples, and PoiDetailSkinWrapper examples
Implement drag & drop that allows dragging residents onto POI capsules with stat validation and visual feedback
Apply Style Lab tokens for theming throughout the integration page
Create /drag-poi-integration route that serves as verification harness with telemetry for tracking drag events

guardrails: DO NOT create new roster or POI components - use existing canonicals
DO NOT modify TimeEngine or time contracts - only use existing time layer
DO NOT hardcode stat validation - use existing validation system
DO NOT create new drag infrastructure - use DragContext/DragOverlay canonics
Ensure time layer usage is consistent with dual-layer architecture
acceptance_criteria: DragPoiIntegrationPage successfully mounts all canonical components
Drag & drop to POI capsules works with stat validation
Visual feedback is provided for drag operations
Style Lab tokens are applied correctly
Time layer usage is consistent (gameplay layer)
Telemetry events are tracked for drag operations
notes: RT-ROSTER-001 verified drag system compliance, RT-POI-S-001 verified POI standard compliance, RT-POI-D-001 verified POI detail compliance. This task integrates these verified systems into a single verification harness.
